localizedDescriptions.en: Navigate generated documentation for public GitHub repositories and ask questions about their code.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 浏览公开 GitHub 仓库的生成式文档，并查询代码相关问题。

en: Map the major components in a public repository and explain how they fit together.
zh-CN: 梳理某个公开仓库的主要组件，并说明它们如何协作。
